sys_pd_process_definition.description: Guides agents through the full lifecycle of a retail complaint — from intake and triage through investigation, remediation, and knowledge-governed closure.
sys_pd_process_definition.label: Retail Complaint Guided Resolution Playbook
sys_pd_process_definition.name: retail_complaint_guided_resolution_playbook

sys_variable_value.value: Create a recovery action record documenting the compensation or voucher issued to the customer.
Ensure a knowledge article documenting the root cause is linked to this complaint.
Before closing this complaint as Closed Complete, verify that a Root Cause KB article reference has been populated on the complaint record. This is a mandatory governance requirement.
Ensure all child tasks are progressing and evidence is attached.
Check the status of any Store Escalation child tasks linked to this complaint. Review all attached photos, receipts, and supporting evidence to ensure completeness before proceeding to remediation.
Review the complaint details, caller information, and initial categorization.
Confirm that the sentiment and repeat customer fields are accurate.
Verify the customer sentiment score and check the repeat customer indicator on the complaint record. Update these fields as needed before proceeding to the investigation stage.
Perform a final review of the complaint record, add closure notes, and set the state to Closed Complete.
